item.title: Countdown Into Neon Night

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical ad for Neon Night, 12 September 2026 at The Foundry, Leeds. Start with a big 3, 2, 1 countdown, building electronic beats and flashing neon, then reveal the event name, date and venue. Hold that end card so I can read it. No talking.

item.tests: Checks a visible descending countdown, synchronized musical buildup, and a readable event reveal rather than a static promo.

answer_sheet.Event wording: Neon Night; 12 September 2026; The Foundry, Leeds
answer_sheet.Countdown: Show 3, then 2, then 1 before revealing the event details.
answer_sheet.Style and pacing: Flashing neon and building electronic beats; hold the final details for at least 3 seconds.
answer_sheet.Language and voice: English text, no talking or voiceover.

must_haves: The video is 8 seconds long in 9:16.
Large numerals appear in the order '3', '2', '1', followed by the event reveal.
Electronic music builds during the countdown, with audible accents matching the numeral changes.
Neon lighting or graphics visibly change during the countdown.
The final card shows 'Neon Night', '12 September 2026' and 'The Foundry, Leeds' together for at least 3 seconds, without clipped text.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical 9:16 neon electronic event advertisement. Full-screen motion graphics, black background with electric cyan and hot magenta neon light accents. Precisely timed structure: 0–1 seconds: enormous centered readable numeral '3', neon accents pulse around it. 1–2 seconds: replace it with enormous centered numeral '2', energy builds. 2–3 seconds: replace it with enormous centered numeral '1', energy builds further. At exactly 3 seconds, reveal a clean professionally typeset end card. From 3–8 seconds hold the SAME end card unchanged, stable and clearly readable, no camera movement. End card text on three centered lines, spelled exactly: 'Neon Night' / '12 September 2026' / 'The Foundry, Leeds'. Make event name largest, date and venue smaller but easily readable with generous spacing and safe margins. No extra text, no logos, no people. Keep text steady, high-contrast and unobscured. Neon accents flash slowly during the countdown, not rapid strobing; settle into a steady neon border around end card. Audio: instrumental electronic dance beats building in intensity through countdown, a satisfying beat drop on the reveal, then electronic rhythm under the held end card. Absolutely no talking, vocals, speech or narration.

**Evaluating production options**

I’m considering a direct minimax approach for 8 seconds, but account info is needed and it's unavailable. There are issues with production cards—no neon flash cards and static backgrounds. I wonder if I can use predetermined cards with colored backgrounds. The user wants scenes to count with specific words. I think using four cards might be the best option since flashing neon isn't recommended. I’ll also need to generate within a default resolution.
I’ll use three seconds for the countdown and hold the event details for the final five seconds, with building electronic beats and no speech.
